Whole identifying faces, hands/actions, wildlife/body vocabulary and factual photographic evidence
Usable response space; no pen, prop, fold, footer or decorative line entering a blank field
No stretched person or source photograph, fake generated learner words or material source-answer cue loss
Adult warmth and variety across memory case, detective board, cassette deck, diary, travel guide, weather archive, first-aid kit, ticket desk and art easel
Credits legibility and observed Unit 7-8/8R active source correspondence
